heard: Most people assume a stellar collapse creates an instant cosmic vacuum cleaner. A black hole is indeed so dense that not even light can escape its gravitational grip. The boundary of no escape is the event horizon, but its reach is surprisingly limited. From a distance, the gravitational field of a black hole is identical to any other body of the same mass. If you replace the sun with a black hole of equal mass, the physics of gravity wouldn't change. While the solar system would grow dark and freezing, the actual path of our planet wouldn't move an inch. Our planets would stay in their current orbits instead of getting sucked inside.
